title: Choose the landing page direction
question: All options keep your brief: clinical calm, deep teal. They differ in what the page is built as. Keep the first, take another, or re-roll.

options.label: The Teaching File
options.lineage: Radiology teaching-file case cards and case-of-the-week conferences
options.thesis: The page is one worked case: what was said, and the report it became.
materials: case card on a deep teal field
report set as the PACS sets it
options.viewport: A deep teal field holding one white case card, Case 01 CT Brain: dictated words down the left margin, the report forming on the right, headline above it and Book a demo beside the case number.
options.risk: Can read as teaching material rather than a product unless the offer and the demo button stay loud.

raised.raise: Normal lines are drawn as deliberately as findings: the whole template is visible in its quiet state and only what was said lights up.
State is carried by line form, not colour alone: normal lines thin, spoken lines full weight, flagged lines double-ruled.
Dictation is shown verbatim, misheard words left standing beside the corrected report line.

options.label: The Signed Report
options.lineage: The typed radiology report on centre letterhead
options.thesis: The whole page is a radiology report about the product itself, ending in a signature block.
materials: signature block as the call to action
options.viewport: One white report sheet on pale teal: letterhead LumenAI, patient line replaced by the visitor, FINDINGS as the pitch, IMPRESSION as the one-line offer with Book a demo.
options.risk: The most literal reading of the product, and a long text document is a quiet opening.

options.label: Seven-Segment Display
options.thesis: The report as a fixed mask of cells where only the abnormal ones light.
options.viewport: A black panel of report lines as ghost cells, findings igniting in red.
options.case: The mask idea fits normal-by-default, but radiologists do not see themselves in consumer LED displays and report prose does not survive a digit mask.
options.kept: Absence drawn as deliberately as light.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.lineage: glass spectrograms on a viewing box
options.thesis: Every element hangs off one calibrated rail; state is line height and dash.
options.viewport: A dark plate crossed by hairlines, each a section of the page.
options.case: Close to the reading room, but one tiny type size and hairlines hide the offer and the demo action.
options.kept: State carried in line form rather than hue.
options.risk: Too cryptic for a first visit.

options.label: Expedition Ice Press
options.lineage: a newspaper hand-set on polar ice
options.thesis: Printed once with the errors left standing.
options.viewport: A small hand-set news sheet announcing the product.
options.case: No link to radiology, and celebrating uncorrected errors contradicts a tool sold on accuracy.
options.kept: The raw input stays visible next to the result.
options.risk: Wrong message for a clinical tool.

options.label: Four-Shade Field
options.thesis: Four greens and an 8 by 8 grid.
options.case: Playful and low-resolution where the audience expects precision.
options.kept: A strictly limited palette, held without exception.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.thesis: The page rises course by course.
options.viewport: Banded clay courses carrying each section.
options.case: Craft warmth with no tie to clinical work, and it fights the teal brief.
options.kept: Each addition visibly rests on what came before.

options.label: Mesophotic Deep Dive
options.thesis: One vertical descent rules the page.
options.viewport: A dive profile with the product at depth.
options.case: The colour is near the brief, but a dive story says nothing about reporting and buries the offer.
options.kept: One axis that every line of the page answers to.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The medical software page visitors expect, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and Book a demo on the left, app screenshot on the right, three benefits below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like Quillr, Somatiq and every other tool in the category.
